Game Overview

Road Fury is a driving title where unleash fury on an endless road as you steer your armed vehicle through waves of relentless traffic. Collect power-ups, dodge enemy fire, and obliterate opponents with your auto-firing roof cannon in this thrilling fusion of racing and shooting, perfect for touchscreen and mouse control.
